#+TITLE: Mux — tmux and Zellij
#+PROPERTY: header-args :mkdirp yes

* Tmux
Colors are dynamically generated by =style.org= via =emit-tmux=.
The emitted =tmux.conf= sources the behavior file below.

** Legacy redirect
Tmux checks =~/.tmux.conf= before the XDG path. This redirect ensures the
old stowed symlink loads the new =~/.config/tmux/tmux.conf= instead.
#+BEGIN_SRC conf :tangle all/.tmux.conf :tangle-mode (identity #o644)
# Redirect to XDG config -- do not edit, see mux.org
source-file ~/DotCortex/all/.config/tmux/tmux.conf
#+END_SRC

** Behavior
#+BEGIN_SRC conf :tangle all/.config/tmux/behavior.conf :tangle-mode (identity #o644)
# ~/.config/tmux/behavior.conf
# Non-theme settings -- sourced from tmux.conf (emitted by style.org)

# --- Basics ---
set -g default-terminal "tmux-256color"
set -ga terminal-overrides ",xterm-256color:Tc,xterm-kitty:Tc,wezterm:Tc"
# Kitty graphics protocol passthrough (tmux >= 3.3) -- lets ranger/yazi/fastfetch
# image previews render inside tmux/herdr panes instead of dying at the multiplexer
set -g allow-passthrough on
set -g mouse on
set -g history-limit 50000
set -g display-time 4000
set -g status-interval 5
set -g focus-events on
set -g extended-keys on
set -g extended-keys-format csi-u
set -g escape-time 0
set -g set-clipboard on

# Start windows and panes at 1
set -g base-index 1
setw -g pane-base-index 1

# Renumber windows when one is closed
set -g renumber-windows on

# --- Prefix ---
set -g prefix C-a
bind C-a send-prefix

# Secondary prefix (nested sessions)
set -g prefix2 C-b
bind C-b send-prefix -2

# --- Vi mode ---
setw -g mode-keys vi
set -g status-keys vi

# Vi-style copy mode
bind -T copy-mode-vi v send-keys -X begin-selection
bind -T copy-mode-vi y send-keys -X copy-pipe-and-cancel "xclip -in -selection clipboard"
bind -T copy-mode-vi r send-keys -X rectangle-toggle

# --- Window/Pane management ---
bind | split-window -h -c "#{pane_current_path}"
bind - split-window -v -c "#{pane_current_path}"
bind t new-window -c "#{pane_current_path}"
bind w confirm-before -p "kill window #W? (y/n)" kill-window

# Vim-style pane navigation
bind h select-pane -L
bind j select-pane -D
bind k select-pane -U
bind l select-pane -R

# Pane resizing
bind -r H resize-pane -L 5
bind -r J resize-pane -D 5
bind -r K resize-pane -U 5
bind -r L resize-pane -R 5

# Window navigation
bind -r PPage previous-window
bind -r NPage next-window

# Swap windows
bind -r S-PPage swap-window -d -t -1
bind -r S-NPage swap-window -d -t +1

# Window picker / clock
bind Tab choose-tree
bind C-c clock-mode

# Reload config
bind r source-file ~/.config/tmux/tmux.conf \; display-message "Config reloaded"

# --- Status bar position ---
set -g status-position top
set -g status-justify left
set -g status-left-length 50
set -g status-right-length 80

# --- Plugins (TPM) ---
set -g @plugin 'tmux-plugins/tpm'
set -g @plugin 'tmux-plugins/tmux-sensible'
set -g @plugin 'tmux-plugins/tmux-resurrect'
set -g @plugin 'tmux-plugins/tmux-continuum'
set -g @plugin 'tmux-plugins/tmux-yank'

# --- Resurrect settings ---
set -g @resurrect-capture-pane-contents 'on'
set -g @resurrect-strategy-nvim 'session'
set -g @resurrect-strategy-vim 'session'
set -g @resurrect-processes 'ssh btop htop nvim vim man less tail top watch claude opencode ~codex->codex'
set -g @resurrect-dir '~/.local/share/tmux/resurrect'
set -g @resurrect-hook-post-restore-all 'run-shell ~/.config/tmux/resurrect-post-restore.sh'

# --- Continuum settings ---
set -g @continuum-save-interval '15'
set -g @continuum-restore 'on'
set -g @continuum-status-on 'off'

# --- Initialize TPM (keep at bottom) ---
set-environment -g TMUX_PLUGIN_MANAGER_PATH '~/.config/tmux/plugins'
run '~/.config/tmux/plugins/tpm/tpm'

# --- DotCortex tmux-resurrect hardening ---
# tmux-resurrect names saves at one-second precision. When two saves land in
# the same second, the second save can delete the file currently targeted by
# "last", leaving a dangling symlink and breaking restores after reboot.
# tmux-continuum executes this option directly; a literal "~" or tmux format is
# not expanded when stored in a variable, so store an absolute path at load time.
run-shell 'tmux set -g @resurrect-save-script-path "$HOME/.local/bin/tmux-resurrect-save-safe"'
unbind C-s
bind C-s run-shell '~/.local/bin/tmux-resurrect-save-safe'
#+END_SRC

** Tmux resurrect save wrapper
#+BEGIN_SRC bash :tangle all/.local/bin/tmux-resurrect-save-safe :shebang "#!/usr/bin/env bash" :tangle-mode (identity #o755)
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

RESURRECT_DIR="${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}/tmux/resurrect"
LAST_LINK="${RESURRECT_DIR}/last"
LOCKDIR="${RESURRECT_DIR}/.save-safe.lock"
UPSTREAM_SAVE="${HOME}/.config/tmux/plugins/tmux-resurrect/scripts/save.sh"

candidate_name() {
  printf 'tmux_resurrect_%s.txt\n' "$(date +"%Y%m%dT%H%M%S")"
}

acquire_lock() {
  mkdir -p "$RESURRECT_DIR"
  while ! mkdir "$LOCKDIR" 2>/dev/null; do
    sleep 0.1
  done
  trap 'rmdir "$LOCKDIR"' EXIT
}

wait_for_fresh_timestamp() {
  local candidate current_last
  while :; do
    candidate="$(candidate_name)"
    current_last="$(readlink "$LAST_LINK" 2>/dev/null || true)"
    if [ "$candidate" != "$current_last" ] && [ ! -e "${RESURRECT_DIR}/${candidate}" ]; then
      return 0
    fi
    sleep 1
  done
}

repair_last_link() {
  local latest
  if [ -L "$LAST_LINK" ] && [ -e "$LAST_LINK" ]; then
    return 0
  fi
  latest="$(ls -1t "$RESURRECT_DIR"/tmux_resurrect_*.txt 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true)"
  if [ -n "$latest" ]; then
    ln -sfn "$(basename "$latest")" "$LAST_LINK"
  fi
}

main() {
  if [ ! -x "$UPSTREAM_SAVE" ]; then
    echo "tmux-resurrect-save-safe: upstream save script not found at $UPSTREAM_SAVE" >&2
    exit 1
  fi

  acquire_lock
  wait_for_fresh_timestamp
  "$UPSTREAM_SAVE" "$@"
  repair_last_link
}

main "$@"
#+END_SRC

** TPM bootstrap script
#+BEGIN_SRC bash :tangle all/.local/bin/tmux-bootstrap :shebang "#!/usr/bin/env bash" :tangle-mode (identity #o755)
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

TPM_DIR="${HOME}/.config/tmux/plugins/tpm"
RESURRECT_DIR="${HOME}/.local/share/tmux/resurrect"

echo "== tmux bootstrap =="

mkdir -p "$RESURRECT_DIR"

if [ ! -d "$TPM_DIR" ]; then
  echo ">> Installing TPM..."
  git clone https://github.com/tmux-plugins/tpm "$TPM_DIR"
  echo ">> TPM installed at $TPM_DIR"
else
  echo ">> TPM already present at $TPM_DIR"
fi

if [ -x "$TPM_DIR/bin/install_plugins" ]; then
  echo ">> Installing tmux plugins..."
  "$TPM_DIR/bin/install_plugins"
  echo ">> Plugins installed."
else
  echo ">> TPM install script not found. Start tmux and press prefix + I."
fi

echo "Done."
#+END_SRC

** Tmux health
#+BEGIN_SRC bash :tangle all/.local/bin/tmux-health :shebang "#!/usr/bin/env bash" :tangle-mode (identity #o755)
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

echo "== tmux health =="

if command -v tmux >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "[tmux] $(tmux -V) at $(command -v tmux)"
else
  echo "[tmux] NOT FOUND"
fi

TPM_DIR="${HOME}/.config/tmux/plugins/tpm"
if [ -d "$TPM_DIR" ]; then
  echo "[tpm] installed at $TPM_DIR"
else
  echo "[tpm] NOT INSTALLED -- run tmux-bootstrap"
fi

for plugin in tmux-resurrect tmux-continuum tmux-yank tmux-sensible; do
  dir="${HOME}/.config/tmux/plugins/$plugin"
  if [ -d "$dir" ]; then
    echo "[$plugin] installed"
  else
    echo "[$plugin] NOT INSTALLED"
  fi
done

RESURRECT_DIR="${HOME}/.local/share/tmux/resurrect"
if [ -d "$RESURRECT_DIR" ]; then
  count=$(find "$RESURRECT_DIR" -name "*.txt" -type f 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
  latest=$(ls -1t "$RESURRECT_DIR"/*.txt 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true)
  echo "[resurrect] $count saves in $RESURRECT_DIR"
  if [ -n "$latest" ]; then
    echo "[resurrect] latest: $(basename "$latest")"
  fi
  if [ -L "$RESURRECT_DIR/last" ]; then
    last_target=$(readlink "$RESURRECT_DIR/last" 2>/dev/null || true)
    echo "[resurrect] last: $last_target"
    if [ -e "$RESURRECT_DIR/last" ]; then
      echo "[resurrect] last link ok"
    else
      echo "[resurrect] last link is dangling"
    fi
  elif [ -e "$RESURRECT_DIR/last" ]; then
    echo "[resurrect] last exists but is not a symlink"
  else
    echo "[resurrect] last is missing"
  fi
else
  echo "[resurrect] save dir not found"
fi

if tmux list-sessions 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "[server] tmux server running"

  save_script=$(tmux show-option -gqv @resurrect-save-script-path 2>/dev/null || true)
  if [ -z "$save_script" ]; then
    echo "[continuum] save-script: not set -- continuum will not save"
  elif [[ "$save_script" == "~/"* ]]; then
    echo "[continuum] save-script: LITERAL TILDE (bug) -- '$save_script' -- continuum saves will fail silently"
  elif [ -x "$save_script" ]; then
    echo "[continuum] save-script: ok ($save_script)"
  else
    echo "[continuum] save-script: NOT EXECUTABLE -- '$save_script'"
  fi

  last_ts=$(tmux show-option -gqv @continuum-save-last-timestamp 2>/dev/null || true)
  if [ -n "$last_ts" ] && [ "$last_ts" -gt 0 ] 2>/dev/null; then
    last_date=$(date -d "@$last_ts" '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S' 2>/dev/null || echo "unknown")
    echo "[continuum] last-save: $last_date"
  else
    echo "[continuum] last-save: never recorded (server just started or option missing)"
  fi
else
  echo "[server] no tmux server"
fi
#+END_SRC

** Tmux submodule ownership
The tmux plugin checkouts below are treated as DotCortex-owned vendor submodules.

- =all/.tmux/plugins/tmux-resurrect= tracks the upstream tmux-resurrect repo.
- =all/.tmux/plugins/tpm= tracks the upstream TPM repo.
- Nested =lib/tmux-test= updates are committed inside the vendor submodule first, then the parent gitlink is advanced.
- Local-only files inside those vendor repos stay local to the submodule; they are not hidden in the parent worktree.

** mux-session
Fleet multiplexer picker: tmux for Linux/WSL hosts, Zellij for Windows hosts.
Uses =fzf= by default. Falls back to the legacy fixed =Cortex= layout when
=fzf= is unavailable or =--legacy= is passed. Windows hosts are detected via
=WINDOWS_HOSTS= and dispatched to =zellij= automatically. Hosts listed in
=WSL_HOSTS= also get a separate =-wsl= tmux lane.
#+BEGIN_SRC bash :tangle all/.local/bin/mux-session :shebang "#!/usr/bin/env bash" :tangle-mode (identity #o755)
# mux-session — fleet multiplexer picker (tmux + Zellij)
# Default: open the fleet session picker.
# Legacy mode: recreate the old fixed Cortex layout.

set -euo pipefail

if [ "${1:-}" = "--legacy" ]; then
  shift
elif command -v fzf >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  canonical_host() {
    local raw="${1:-}"
    local lower="${raw,,}"

    if [[ "$lower" == *x230* ]]; then
      printf '%s\n' "x230"
    elif [[ "$lower" == *t480s* ]]; then
      printf '%s\n' "t480s"
    elif [[ "$lower" == *t480* ]]; then
      printf '%s\n' "t480"
    else
      printf '%s\n' "${raw%%.*}"
    fi
  }

  trim() {
    local value="${1:-}"
    value="${value#"${value%%[![:space:]]*}"}"
    value="${value%"${value##*[![:space:]]}"}"
    printf '%s\n' "$value"
  }

  quote_sh() {
    printf "'%s'" "$(printf '%s' "$1" | sed "s/'/'\\\\''/g")"
  }

  quote_powershell() {
    printf "'%s'" "${1//\'/\'\'}"
  }

  zellij_background_attach_command() {
    local session_name="$1"
    # Launch zellij through PowerShell — the sanctioned Windows runtime shell per the
    # Git Bash Doctrine (Git Bash must NEVER be a runtime shell: it flashes consoles
    # on any repeated/background path). powershell.exe has no space in its path, so it
    # survives cmd.exe's ConPTY quoting under `ssh -t`, and ';' is a real statement
    # separator there. Do NOT route through bare `bash` (resolves to WSL on
    # WSL-equipped hosts, no zellij) or Git Bash (doctrine violation; MSYS2 only
    # "persists" by daemonizing, which is the popup-spawning behaviour we forbid).
    # Persistent sessions are owned by the Zellij Watchdog (a detached Start-Process);
    # a client attach/disconnect over SSH never kills that server, so attach --create
    # is correct — it attaches to the watchdog-owned session when it already exists.
    printf 'powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "zellij.exe attach --create %s"' \
      "$(quote_powershell "$session_name")"
  }

  attach_local() {
    local lane="$1"
    local session_name="$2"
    if [ "$lane" = "herdr" ]; then
      # herdr --session is use-or-create: it attaches the named persistent
      # session or spins one up, so it works for both attach and create.
      exec herdr --session "$session_name"
    fi
    TMUX="" exec tmux attach-session -t "$session_name"
  }

  create_local() {
    local lane="$1"
    local session_name="$2"
    if [ "$lane" = "herdr" ]; then
      exec herdr --session "$session_name"
    fi
    tmux has-session -t "$session_name" 2>/dev/null || tmux new-session -d -s "$session_name"
    TMUX="" exec tmux attach-session -t "$session_name"
  }

  wsl_tmux_command() {
    local tmux_args="$1"
    printf 'wsl.exe -- bash -lc "%s"' \
      "$(printf 'exec tmux %s' "$tmux_args" | sed 's/\\/\\\\/g; s/"/\\"/g')"
  }

  attach_remote() {
    local host="$1"
    local lane="$2"
    local session_name="$3"
    if [ "$lane" = "zellij" ]; then
      TERM=xterm-256color ssh -t "$host" "$(zellij_background_attach_command "$session_name")"
    elif [ "$lane" = "wsl" ]; then
      TERM=xterm-256color ssh -t "$host" "$(wsl_tmux_command "attach-session -t $(quote_sh "$session_name")")"
    elif [ "$lane" = "herdr" ]; then
      TERM=xterm-256color ssh -t "$host" "PATH=\"\$HOME/.local/bin:\$PATH\" herdr --session $(quote_sh "$session_name")"
    else
      TERM=xterm-256color ssh -t "$host" "tmux attach-session -t $(quote_sh "$session_name")"
    fi
    exit $?
  }

  create_remote() {
    local host="$1"
    local lane="$2"
    local session_name="$3"
    if [ "$lane" = "zellij" ]; then
      TERM=xterm-256color ssh -t "$host" "$(zellij_background_attach_command "$session_name")"
    elif [ "$lane" = "wsl" ]; then
      TERM=xterm-256color ssh -t "$host" "$(wsl_tmux_command "new-session -A -s $(quote_sh "$session_name")")"
    elif [ "$lane" = "herdr" ]; then
      TERM=xterm-256color ssh -t "$host" "PATH=\"\$HOME/.local/bin:\$PATH\" herdr --session $(quote_sh "$session_name")"
    else
      TERM=xterm-256color ssh -t "$host" "tmux new-session -A -s $(quote_sh "$session_name")"
    fi
    exit $?
  }

  prompt_session_name() {
    local host="$1"
    local session_name

    printf 'New session on %s: ' "$host" >&2
    read -r session_name
    session_name="$(trim "$session_name")"
    if [ -z "$session_name" ]; then
      echo "mux-session: session name is required" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    if [[ "$session_name" == *:* ]]; then
      echo "mux-session: session names cannot contain ':'" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
    printf '%s\n' "$session_name"
  }

  list_local_sessions() {
    tmux list-sessions -F '#{session_name}|#{session_windows}|#{?session_attached,attached,detached}' 2>/dev/null || true
  }

  list_local_herdr_sessions() {
    command -v herdr >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 0
    # `herdr session list` prints a header row then `name status directory socket`.
    # Reshape to the tmux row contract `name|windows|attached` — windows is
    # unknown for herdr (?), and the status (stopped/running) rides the last col.
    herdr session list 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR>1 && NF { printf "%s|?|%s\n", $1, $2 }' || true
  }

  list_remote_linux_sessions() {
    # Single SSH round-trip: tmux sessions, a sentinel, then herdr sessions.
    # Splitting the sentinel locally yields both lanes without a second probe.
    # Non-interactive SSH does not source .zshenv on every host (e.g. gillean-aio,
    # never stowed by DotCortex), so herdr's ~/.local/bin is not reliably on PATH.
    # Prefix it explicitly rather than assuming the remote shell put it there;
    # `command -v` still guards hosts without herdr installed.
    local host="$1"
    # PATH is set as its own statement (not a per-command prefix) so it stays in
    # effect for both the `command -v` guard and the `herdr session list` call
    # that follows it in the same remote shell.
    ssh_probe "$host" "PATH=\"\$HOME/.local/bin:\$PATH\"; tmux list-sessions -F '#{session_name}|#{session_windows}|#{?session_attached,attached,detached}' 2>/dev/null; echo '$HERDR_SENTINEL'; command -v herdr >/dev/null 2>&1 && herdr session list 2>/dev/null" 2>/dev/null || true
  }

  list_remote_zellij_sessions() {
    local host="$1"
    # zellij ls outputs ANSI-coloured quoted names: 'SessionName' [Created Xh ago]
    # Strip ANSI codes, extract name/state, skip blanks.
    # /dev/null does not exist on Windows — redirect stderr locally, not on the remote.
    # || true mirrors list_remote_linux_sessions: unreachable host must not abort build_menu.
    ssh_probe "$host" "powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command \"zellij.exe list-sessions --no-formatting\"" 2>/dev/null \
      | sed -E "s/\x1b\[[0-9;]*[mGKHF]//g" \
      | grep -E "\[Created" \
      | while IFS= read -r line; do
          name="$(printf '%s\n' "$line" | sed -E "s/^'?([^' ]+)'? .*/\1/")"
          [ -n "$name" ] || continue
          if [[ "$line" == *"(EXITED"* ]]; then
            printf '%s|?|exited\n' "$name"
          else
            printf '%s|?|running\n' "$name"
          fi
        done || true
  }

  list_remote_wsl_tmux_sessions() {
    local host="$1"
    ssh_probe "$host" "$(wsl_tmux_command "list-sessions -F '#{session_name}|#{session_windows}|#{?session_attached,attached,detached}' 2>/dev/null")" 2>/dev/null || true
  }

  emit_host_menu() {
    local host="$1"
    local lane="$2"
    local label="$3"
    local rows="$4"
    local name windows attached

    if [ -n "$rows" ]; then
      while IFS='|' read -r name windows attached; do
        [ -n "${name:-}" ] || continue
        printf 'attach\t%s\t%s\t%s\tresume  %-10s %-10s %-24s %2sw %s\n' \
          "$host" "$lane" "$name" "$label" "$host" "$name" "$windows" "$attached"
      done <<< "$rows"
    fi

    printf 'create\t%s\t%s\t\tcreate  %-10s %-10s %s\n' \
      "$host" "$lane" "$label" "$host" "new session"
  }

  build_menu() {
    local host rows herdr_rows combined

    for host in "${HOSTS[@]}"; do
      if [ "$host" = "$LOCAL_HOST" ]; then
        rows="$(list_local_sessions)"
        emit_host_menu "$host" "local" "local" "$rows"
        # herdr is a local socket call — free to enumerate, so list real
        # herdr sessions alongside a create entry.
        herdr_rows="$(list_local_herdr_sessions)"
        emit_host_menu "$host" "herdr" "herdr" "$herdr_rows"
      elif [ -n "${WINDOWS_HOSTS[$host]:-}" ]; then
        rows="$(list_remote_zellij_sessions "$host")"
        emit_host_menu "$host" "zellij" "zellij" "$rows"
        if [ -n "${WSL_HOSTS[$host]:-}" ]; then
          rows="$(list_remote_wsl_tmux_sessions "$host")"
          emit_host_menu "$host" "wsl" "wsl-tmux" "$rows"
        fi
      else
        combined="$(list_remote_linux_sessions "$host")"
        rows="$(printf '%s\n' "$combined" \
          | awk -v s="$HERDR_SENTINEL" '$0==s{exit} NF{print}')"
        emit_host_menu "$host" "ssh" "ssh-tmux" "$rows"
        # herdr rows follow the sentinel; first post-sentinel line is the
        # `name status directory socket` header — skip it, reshape the rest to
        # the `name|windows|attached` contract (windows unknown -> ?, status
        # rides col 2). Empty herdr section (herdr absent, or no sessions) ->
        # emit_host_menu prints just the `create` line, so herdr stays a
        # one-keystroke option on every Linux remote.
        herdr_rows="$(printf '%s\n' "$combined" | awk -v s="$HERDR_SENTINEL" '
          $0==s { seen=1; hdr=1; next }
          seen && hdr { hdr=0; next }
          seen && NF { printf "%s|?|%s\n", $1, $2 }')"
        emit_host_menu "$host" "herdr" "herdr" "$herdr_rows"
      fi
    done
  }

  LOCAL_HOST="$(canonical_host "$(hostname -s 2>/dev/null || hostname)")"
  declare -a HOSTS=()
  declare -A SEEN_HOSTS=()
  declare -A WINDOWS_HOSTS=(["gillean"]=1 ["judith"]=1 ["z1x"]=1 ["maximus"]=1)
  declare -A WSL_HOSTS=(["gillean"]=1 ["judith"]=1)
  HERDR_SENTINEL='__MUX_HERDR_SENTINEL__'
  SSH_OPTS=(
    -o BatchMode=yes
    -o ConnectTimeout=2
    -o ConnectionAttempts=1
    -o RequestTTY=no
  )

  # ConnectTimeout/ConnectionAttempts only bound the TCP handshake -- never a
  # remote command that hangs *after* connecting (e.g. a Windows host that is
  # up but whose `wsl.exe ... tmux list-sessions` wedges while WSL is cold).
  # Without an overall cap, one hung probe blocks build_menu forever and the
  # fzf picker never renders. ssh_probe bounds the whole probe; -k 1 SIGKILLs
  # ssh if it ignores SIGTERM. Used for listing only -- never for attach.
  PROBE_TIMEOUT=4
  ssh_probe() {
    if command -v timeout >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      timeout -k 1 "$PROBE_TIMEOUT" ssh "${SSH_OPTS[@]}" "$@"
    else
      ssh "${SSH_OPTS[@]}" "$@"
    fi
  }

  add_host() {
    local host
    host="$(canonical_host "$1")"
    [ -n "$host" ] || return 0
    [ -n "${SEEN_HOSTS[$host]:-}" ] && return 0
    SEEN_HOSTS["$host"]=1
    HOSTS+=("$host")
  }

  if [ -n "${TMUX_SESSION_HOSTS:-}" ]; then
    for host in ${TMUX_SESSION_HOSTS}; do
      add_host "$host"
    done
  else
    add_host "$LOCAL_HOST"
    add_host x230
    add_host t480
    add_host t480s
    add_host gillean
    add_host gillean-aio
    add_host haggis
    add_host beelink
    add_host judith
    add_host s24
    add_host z1x
    add_host maximus
    add_host vivi-t530
    add_host vivi
  fi

  mapfile -t PICKED < <(
    build_menu | fzf \
      --height=70% \
      --layout=reverse \
      --border \
      --prompt='mux> ' \
      --header='Enter: attach/create, type to filter' \
      --delimiter=$'\t' \
      --with-nth=5
  )

  SELECTION="${PICKED[0]:-}"

  [ -n "$SELECTION" ] || exit 0

  IFS=$'\t' read -r ACTION HOST LANE SESSION_NAME _ <<< "$SELECTION"

  if [ "$ACTION" = "create" ]; then
    SESSION_NAME="$(prompt_session_name "$HOST")"
  fi

  if [ "$HOST" = "$LOCAL_HOST" ]; then
    if [ "$ACTION" = "attach" ]; then
      attach_local "$LANE" "$SESSION_NAME"
    fi
    create_local "$LANE" "$SESSION_NAME"
  fi

  if [ "$ACTION" = "attach" ]; then
    attach_remote "$HOST" "$LANE" "$SESSION_NAME"
  fi

  create_remote "$HOST" "$LANE" "$SESSION_NAME"
fi

SESSION="Cortex"
HOST="$(hostname)"

# Attach if session exists
if tmux has-session -t "$SESSION" 2>/dev/null; then
  exec tmux attach-session -t "$SESSION"
fi

# --- T480s layout ---
if [[ "$HOST" == *T480s* || "$HOST" == *t480s* ]]; then
  tmux new-session -d -s "$SESSION" -n "t480s" -c "$HOME/DotCortex"
  tmux new-window  -t "$SESSION" -n "x230"
  # X230 window: ssh into x230 (will reconnect if host available)
  tmux send-keys -t "$SESSION:x230" "ssh x230 -t 'tmux attach -t Cortex 2>/dev/null || tmux new -s Cortex'" Enter

# --- X230 layout ---
elif [[ "$HOST" == *X230* || "$HOST" == *x230* ]]; then
  tmux new-session -d -s "$SESSION" -n "x230" -c "$HOME/DotCortex"
  tmux new-window  -t "$SESSION" -n "t480s"
  tmux send-keys -t "$SESSION:t480s" "ssh t480s -t 'tmux attach -t Cortex 2>/dev/null || tmux new -s Cortex'" Enter

# --- Generic fallback ---
else
  tmux new-session -d -s "$SESSION" -n "main" -c "$HOME/DotCortex"
fi

# Select the local window and attach
tmux select-window -t "$SESSION:1"
exec tmux attach-session -t "$SESSION"
#+END_SRC

** Tmux resurrect hooks for Claude Code / OpenCode
Resurrect saves and restores processes listed in =@resurrect-processes=.
Claude Code (=claude=) and OpenCode (=opencode=) are already in the list.
For Claude, resurrection works via =claude --resume <id>= which is what
the restored shell history will contain. For full automatic resume, we add
a resurrect hook that detects claude sessions and offers to resume them.
#+BEGIN_SRC bash :tangle all/.config/tmux/resurrect-post-restore.sh :shebang "#!/usr/bin/env bash" :tangle-mode (identity #o755)
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Post-restore hook for tmux-resurrect
# Checks for recent claude/opencode sessions and notifies user

CLAUDE_SESSIONS="$HOME/.claude/projects"
if [ -d "$CLAUDE_SESSIONS" ]; then
  latest=$(find "$CLAUDE_SESSIONS" -name "*.jsonl" -mmin -720 -type f 2>/dev/null | head -1)
  if [ -n "$latest" ]; then
    tmux display-message "Claude Code sessions available. Use 'claude --resume' to restore."
  fi
fi
#+END_SRC

* Zellij

** Windows config (win overlay)
Deployed to =%APPDATA%\zellij\config.kdl= on Windows machines.
Not stowed — copy via =scp= or the deploy helper when provisioning a new rig.
LainCore theme, =Ctrl a= prefix, locked default, Colemak-NEIO bindings.
#+BEGIN_SRC conf :tangle win/.config/zellij/config.kdl :tangle-mode (identity #o644)
// Zellij config — LainCore theme, locked default, Ctrl a prefix
// Source: PalmCortex reference (GoldenAge_Loom/PalmCortex/docs/zellij-windows-client.kdl)
// TODO(org): mode-specific h/j/k/l bindings need full Colemak-NEIO pass (n/e/i/o)

keybinds clear-defaults=true {
    locked {
        bind "Ctrl a" { SwitchToMode "normal"; }
    }
    pane {
        bind "left"  { MoveFocus "left"; }
        bind "down"  { MoveFocus "down"; }
        bind "up"    { MoveFocus "up"; }
        bind "right" { MoveFocus "right"; }
        bind "n"  { MoveFocus "left"; }
        bind "e"  { MoveFocus "down"; }
        bind "i"  { MoveFocus "up"; }
        bind "o"  { MoveFocus "right"; }
        bind "c" { SwitchToMode "renamepane"; PaneNameInput 0; }
        bind "d" { NewPane "down"; SwitchToMode "locked"; }
        bind "f" { ToggleFocusFullscreen; SwitchToMode "locked"; }
        bind "p" { SwitchToMode "normal"; }
        bind "r" { NewPane "right"; SwitchToMode "locked"; }
        bind "s" { NewPane "stacked"; SwitchToMode "locked"; }
        bind "w" { ToggleFloatingPanes; SwitchToMode "locked"; }
        bind "x" { CloseFocus; SwitchToMode "locked"; }
        bind "z" { TogglePaneFrames; SwitchToMode "locked"; }
        bind "tab" { SwitchFocus; }
    }
    tab {
        bind "left"  { GoToPreviousTab; }
        bind "down"  { GoToNextTab; }
        bind "up"    { GoToPreviousTab; }
        bind "right" { GoToNextTab; }
        bind "n" { GoToPreviousTab; }
        bind "e" { GoToNextTab; }
        bind "1" { GoToTab 1; SwitchToMode "locked"; }
        bind "2" { GoToTab 2; SwitchToMode "locked"; }
        bind "3" { GoToTab 3; SwitchToMode "locked"; }
        bind "4" { GoToTab 4; SwitchToMode "locked"; }
        bind "5" { GoToTab 5; SwitchToMode "locked"; }
        bind "6" { GoToTab 6; SwitchToMode "locked"; }
        bind "7" { GoToTab 7; SwitchToMode "locked"; }
        bind "8" { GoToTab 8; SwitchToMode "locked"; }
        bind "9" { GoToTab 9; SwitchToMode "locked"; }
        bind "[" { BreakPaneLeft; SwitchToMode "locked"; }
        bind "]" { BreakPaneRight; SwitchToMode "locked"; }
        bind "b" { BreakPane; SwitchToMode "locked"; }
        bind "N" { NewTab; SwitchToMode "locked"; }
        bind "r" { SwitchToMode "renametab"; TabNameInput 0; }
        bind "s" { ToggleActiveSyncTab; SwitchToMode "locked"; }
        bind "t" { SwitchToMode "normal"; }
        bind "x" { CloseTab; SwitchToMode "locked"; }
        bind "tab" { ToggleTab; }
    }
    resize {
        bind "left"  { Resize "Increase left"; }
        bind "down"  { Resize "Increase down"; }
        bind "up"    { Resize "Increase up"; }
        bind "right" { Resize "Increase right"; }
        bind "n"  { Resize "Increase left"; }
        bind "e"  { Resize "Increase down"; }
        bind "i"  { Resize "Increase up"; }
        bind "o"  { Resize "Increase right"; }
        bind "N"  { Resize "Decrease left"; }
        bind "E"  { Resize "Decrease down"; }
        bind "I"  { Resize "Decrease up"; }
        bind "O"  { Resize "Decrease right"; }
        bind "+"  { Resize "Increase"; }
        bind "-"  { Resize "Decrease"; }
        bind "="  { Resize "Increase"; }
        bind "r"  { SwitchToMode "normal"; }
    }
    move {
        bind "left"  { MovePane "left"; }
        bind "down"  { MovePane "down"; }
        bind "up"    { MovePane "up"; }
        bind "right" { MovePane "right"; }
        bind "n" { MovePane "left"; }
        bind "e" { MovePane "down"; }
        bind "i" { MovePane "up"; }
        bind "o" { MovePane "right"; }
        bind "m" { SwitchToMode "normal"; }
        bind "tab" { MovePane; }
    }
    scroll {
        bind "Alt left"  { MoveFocusOrTab "left"; SwitchToMode "locked"; }
        bind "Alt down"  { MoveFocus "down"; SwitchToMode "locked"; }
        bind "Alt up"    { MoveFocus "up"; SwitchToMode "locked"; }
        bind "Alt right" { MoveFocusOrTab "right"; SwitchToMode "locked"; }
        bind "Alt n"     { MoveFocusOrTab "left"; SwitchToMode "locked"; }
        bind "Alt e"     { MoveFocus "down"; SwitchToMode "locked"; }
        bind "Alt i"     { MoveFocus "up"; SwitchToMode "locked"; }
        bind "Alt o"     { MoveFocusOrTab "right"; SwitchToMode "locked"; }
        bind "f" { SwitchToMode "entersearch"; SearchInput 0; }
        bind "s" { SwitchToMode "normal"; }
        bind "e" { EditScrollback; SwitchToMode "locked"; }
    }
    search {
        bind "c" { SearchToggleOption "CaseSensitivity"; }
        bind "n" { Search "down"; }
        bind "p" { Search "up"; }
        bind "o" { SearchToggleOption "WholeWord"; }
        bind "w" { SearchToggleOption "Wrap"; }
    }
    session {
        bind "a" {
            LaunchOrFocusPlugin "zellij:about" {
                floating true
                move_to_focused_tab true
            }
            SwitchToMode "locked"
        }
        bind "c" {
            LaunchOrFocusPlugin "configuration" {
                floating true
                move_to_focused_tab true
            }
            SwitchToMode "locked"
        }
        bind "d" { Detach; }
        bind "l" {
            LaunchOrFocusPlugin "zellij:layout-manager" {
                floating true
                move_to_focused_tab true
            }
            SwitchToMode "locked"
        }
        bind "o" { SwitchToMode "normal"; }
        bind "p" {
            LaunchOrFocusPlugin "plugin-manager" {
                floating true
                move_to_focused_tab true
            }
            SwitchToMode "locked"
        }
        bind "w" {
            LaunchOrFocusPlugin "session-manager" {
                floating true
                move_to_focused_tab true
            }
            SwitchToMode "locked"
        }
    }
    shared_among "normal" "locked" {
        bind "Alt left"  { MoveFocusOrTab "left"; }
        bind "Alt down"  { MoveFocus "down"; }
        bind "Alt up"    { MoveFocus "up"; }
        bind "Alt right" { MoveFocusOrTab "right"; }
        bind "Alt n"     { MoveFocusOrTab "left"; }
        bind "Alt e"     { MoveFocus "down"; }
        bind "Alt i"     { MoveFocus "up"; }
        bind "Alt o"     { MoveFocusOrTab "right"; }
        bind "Alt N"     { MoveTab "left"; }
        bind "Alt O"     { MoveTab "right"; }
        bind "Alt +"     { Resize "Increase"; }
        bind "Alt -"     { Resize "Decrease"; }
        bind "Alt ="     { Resize "Increase"; }
        bind "Alt ["     { PreviousSwapLayout; }
        bind "Alt ]"     { NextSwapLayout; }
        bind "Alt f"     { ToggleFloatingPanes; }
        bind "Alt p"     { TogglePaneInGroup; }
        bind "Alt Shift p" { ToggleGroupMarking; }
    }
    shared_except "locked" "renametab" "renamepane" {
        bind "Ctrl a" { SwitchToMode "locked"; }
        bind "Ctrl q" { Quit; }
    }
    shared_except "locked" "entersearch" {
        bind "enter" { SwitchToMode "locked"; }
    }
    shared_except "locked" "entersearch" "renametab" "renamepane" {
        bind "esc" { SwitchToMode "locked"; }
    }
    shared_except "locked" "entersearch" "renametab" "renamepane" "move" {
        bind "m" { SwitchToMode "move"; }
    }
    shared_except "locked" "entersearch" "search" "renametab" "renamepane" "session" {
        bind "o" { SwitchToMode "session"; }
    }
    shared_except "locked" "tab" "entersearch" "renametab" "renamepane" {
        bind "t" { SwitchToMode "tab"; }
    }
    shared_among "normal" "resize" "tab" "scroll" "prompt" "tmux" {
        bind "p" { SwitchToMode "pane"; }
    }
    shared_among "normal" "resize" "search" "move" "prompt" "tmux" {
        bind "s" { SwitchToMode "scroll"; }
    }
    shared_except "locked" "resize" "pane" "tab" "entersearch" "renametab" "renamepane" {
        bind "r" { SwitchToMode "resize"; }
    }
    shared_among "scroll" "search" {
        bind "PageDown" { PageScrollDown; }
        bind "PageUp"   { PageScrollUp; }
        bind "left"     { PageScrollUp; }
        bind "down"     { ScrollDown; }
        bind "up"       { ScrollUp; }
        bind "right"    { PageScrollDown; }
        bind "Ctrl b"   { PageScrollUp; }
        bind "Ctrl c"   { ScrollToBottom; SwitchToMode "locked"; }
        bind "d"        { HalfPageScrollDown; }
        bind "Ctrl f"   { PageScrollDown; }
        bind "u"        { HalfPageScrollUp; }
        bind "e"        { ScrollDown; }
        bind "i"        { ScrollUp; }
    }
    entersearch {
        bind "Ctrl c" { SwitchToMode "scroll"; }
        bind "esc"    { SwitchToMode "scroll"; }
        bind "enter"  { SwitchToMode "search"; }
    }
    renametab {
        bind "esc" { UndoRenameTab; SwitchToMode "tab"; }
    }
    shared_among "renametab" "renamepane" {
        bind "Ctrl c" { SwitchToMode "locked"; }
    }
    renamepane {
        bind "esc" { UndoRenamePane; SwitchToMode "pane"; }
    }
}

* Herdr

** Config
Prefix set to =ctrl+a= to match the Tmux and Zellij prefix above. Theme and UI settings carried over from the live config. Pane-focus and navigate-mode bindings use Colemak-NEIO (=n=/=e=/=i=/=o= for left/down/up/right) instead of the =h=/=j=/=k=/=l= defaults. That collides with herdr's own defaults for =edit_scrollback= (=prefix+e=) and =open_notification_target= (=prefix+o=), so those two move to =prefix+shift+e=/=prefix+shift+o= (shift keeps the original mnemonic letter where the plain key was claimed by movement). Tab cycling uses =prefix+left=/=prefix+right= (PageUp/PageDown was tried first but herdr's keybind parser rejects it outright, confirmed via =reload-config= diagnostics); agent cycling (previously unset in herdr's defaults) uses =prefix+up=/=prefix+down=. =close_workspace= and =workspace_picker= are swapped from their defaults (=prefix+shift+d= and =prefix+w=) to =prefix+w= and =prefix+a= respectively. =new_tab= moves from its default =prefix+c= to =prefix+t= to match the Tmux =bind t new-window= convention above. =[terminal] default_shell= is pinned to Bash (for flyline) for new panes -- system default shell stays zsh, this only affects panes herdr spawns.
#+BEGIN_SRC toml :tangle all/.config/herdr/config.toml :tangle-mode (identity #o644)
[terminal]
default_shell = "/usr/bin/bash"

[keys]
prefix = "ctrl+a"
focus_pane_left = "prefix+n"
focus_pane_down = "prefix+e"
focus_pane_up = "prefix+i"
focus_pane_right = "prefix+o"
navigate_pane_left = "n"
navigate_pane_down = "e"
navigate_pane_up = "i"
navigate_pane_right = "o"
previous_tab = "prefix+left"
next_tab = "prefix+right"
previous_agent = "prefix+up"
next_agent = "prefix+down"
edit_scrollback = "prefix+shift+e"
open_notification_target = "prefix+shift+o"
close_workspace = "prefix+w"
workspace_picker = "prefix+a"
new_tab = "prefix+t"

[ui]
agent_panel_sort = "spaces"
show_agent_labels_on_pane_borders = true

[theme]
name = "gruvbox"
auto_switch = false

[ui.toast]
delivery = "system"

# Kitty graphics in panes (yazi/chafa image previews) — upstream-experimental since 0.5.9,
# confirmed required-on by field reports (default-off renders nothing). Known gap: images
# inside nvim panes may still show blank (upstream issue). Perplexity-verified 2026-07-10.
[experimental]
kitty_graphics = true
#+END_SRC
